svg.title: MediaLog: an arcade cocktail table in attract mode
svg.desc: A cocktail-table arcade seen from above, with player 1 (1UP: ME) at the bottom and player 2 (2UP: FRIENDS) across the table, a mug of tea, a remote, headphones and a paperback beside the controls. Every score on the screen is a date. The attract loop hard-cuts between a title card (MediaLog in striped letters, one stripe per kind colour, and EVERYTHING YOU'VE WATCHED, READ, PLAYED, LISTENED TO, ON ONE TIMELINE, with a rolling verb), a how-to-play card with the kinds and their colours, a demo where the MediaLog book walks the timeline five years to a screen, a high-score table of friends' entries ranked by date, not by taste, and a turn for player 2 with the picture upside down. WHAT DID YOU PLAY? blinks along the bottom.
